baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعْبُدُونَ / لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا / فَٱبْتَغُوا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا لَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah audits worship through dependency: submission treats its object as master and sustaining patron. It denies the substitutes any ownership or disposal of the allotted benefit, then reallocates seeking, service, and gratitude to the giver.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the enacted dependency whose proper object the repeated verbs relocate.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the precise capacity denied to the substitutes.
An allotted gift or benefit is the dependency-bearing good first denied and then redirected.
Active seeking makes the redirection a practical pursuit rather than a bare doctrinal correction.
Recognition of benefit closes the chain by assigning the gift to its actual giver.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts worshiping idols with worshiping and thanking God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes a patronage error: people submit where they imagine sustenance is controlled, while the supposed patrons possess no such capacity; seeking, service, and acknowledgment must therefore follow the real provision relation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees do not merely repeat a false statement. They form a counterfeit account, give a made object the fixed standing of a god, and then submit to their own product, reversing maker and made.

activation_trace.role: Fabricating false speech supplies the explicit human production of the counterfeit account.
Estimating and shaping supplies the constructive process by which the false account is fitted into a usable form.
Turning something away from its proper direction supplies the reversal between creator, artifact, and worshiper.
A lie diverted from truth identifies the manufactured product as a counter-reality, not neutral craft.
Apparent strength and fixity explain how the artifact can be granted durable standing despite being made.

changed_reading.before: They make idols and tell lies about them.
changed_reading.after: They manufacture a stable-seeming counter-reality and then inhabit its inverted hierarchy: the makers become servants of what they themselves have fixed in place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ... فَٱبْتَغُوا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ... إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah draws a directional sequence. The substitutes occupy a position short of or other than the goal; provision is sought in God's presence and authority; return terminates every detour at the originating destination.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that falls short of the endpoint supplies the image of an attractive but terminally inadequate stop.
Otherness and lower rank mark the substitutes as displaced alternatives rather than rival sources.
Nearness and presence provide the positive destination for seeking.
Return to an originating direction closes the spatial and existential vector.

changed_reading.before: The verse says to abandon other gods, ask God for provision, and remember the final return.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps misdirected dependence as stopping short: its imperatives resume movement toward the true source, while the final passive return declares that every substitute route ends at God anyway.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah pressure turns worship from a label into an assay of effective obedience. Profession is tested, and even intimate authority may not be obeyed when it recruits one into association; the focus verbs therefore identify the master actually followed under cost.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience is the focus anchor whose practical allegiance is being tested.
Assaying metal or a person supplies pressure as the means by which declared allegiance becomes observable.
Compliance and obedience identify the concrete behavior withheld from coercive kin.
Association with God names the boundary at which ordinary relational obedience becomes rival allegiance.

structural_cues: 29:2 places testing immediately after the verbal claim of belief.
29:8 joins family pressure, refusal of obedience, return, and disclosure of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profession under assay and a command not to obey coercive parents into association; I infer that pressure reveals the operative object of service. A live alternative is that ع ب د remains primarily cultic while obedience is only an analogy.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a ritual act directed to the wrong object.
changed_reading.after: Worship is the allegiance that survives pressure and governs obedience; the focus asks not only what is ritually addressed but which claimant becomes master when loyalty costs something.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to follow a group's path is marketed with a guarantee to carry another's liabilities, but the guarantors cannot transfer the burden and instead acquire additional weight. This revises the focus's powerless providers into false patrons who promise both benefit and risk absorption without possessing either.

activation_trace.role: Power of possession and disposal is the focus capacity against which the patrons' promise is audited.
Allotted benefit supplies the positive side of the promised patronage relation.
Following behind supplies recruitment into dependence on the speakers' route.
A traversable extended road makes the offered allegiance a directed social course.
Guarantee and surety expose the speakers' offer as a liability-transfer contract that they cannot perform.
Weight supplies the nontransferable and compounding liability concealed by the offer.
Invented falsehood identifies the guarantee itself as manufactured patronage.

structural_cues: 29:12 repeats carrying in promise and denial; 29:13 answers with each party's own loads plus added loads.
The focus similarly places claimed allegiance beside an explicit denial of the patron's operative capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, a surety promise, its failure, and compounded burdens; I infer an analogy between promised liability absorption and promised sustenance. The alternative is that the burden episode concerns only moral accountability, not economic patronage.

changed_reading.before: The idols cannot give material provision.
changed_reading.after: The focus audits every patronage claim attached to allegiance: false masters cannot secure benefits or absorb the liabilities by which they recruit dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates origination, re-creation, and truth-grounded creation from human making and fabrication. The focus's تخلقون إفكًا becomes counterfeit world-production: a made account borrows the grammar of creation but cannot begin, sustain, or restore what is real.

activation_trace.role: Fabricating a lie anchors the focus's human pseudo-creation.
A lie diverted from truth identifies the product's false ontological claim.
Opening and initiating supply the generative capacity absent from the fabricated counter-world.
Return after departure supplies re-creation as a second test of genuine creative power.
Stable correspondence with reality places divine creation on the opposite side of the focus's إفك.
Making a thing extends the focus's charge from speech into observable human production.
Cutting together an invented lie names the terminal form of counterfeit authorship.

structural_cues: 29:19-20 repeat beginning, creation, return, and new origination just after the focus.
29:44 pairs God's creation with truth; 29:45 closes with God's knowledge of what people make; 29:68 pairs fabrication with lying against God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine beginning and return, creation with truth, human making, and fabricated lying; I infer a polemic between reality-producing creation and counterfeit world-making. The live alternative is the narrower sense 'compose a lie' without an ontological contrast.

changed_reading.before: تخلقون إفكًا means that the addressees invent a lie.
changed_reading.after: The phrase accuses them of counterfeit creation: they compose a social-religious reality that mimics creative authority while lacking the power to originate, restore, or ground anything in truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later turns إفك from a false object into a directional condition: people acknowledge the creator and cosmic order yet are passively turned away. The focus's final return, reinforced by being turned back to God, becomes the counterturn that defeats this misorientation.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from a proper direction anchors falsehood as a vector rather than only a proposition.
Return to the originating direction supplies the focus's terminal counter-movement.
Turning a thing from its face makes the coming reversal of orientation explicit.
Subjection of the cosmos to a purpose supplies acknowledged ordered agency before the irrational turn away.
The passive turning-away applies the focus root to the worshipers themselves and reveals misorientation as something enacted upon them.

structural_cues: 29:21 closely echoes the focus's return with the stronger image 'you are turned over/back.'
29:61 juxtaposes explicit acknowledgment that God created and ordered the cosmos with 'how are they turned away?'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acknowledged cosmic authorship, passive diversion, and passive return/counterturn; I infer one directional mechanism linking cognition, worship, and destiny. An alternative is that the passive verbs merely share eschatological rhetoric without forming a deliberate vector pair.

changed_reading.before: إفك is the lie they manufacture, and return is a separate warning.
changed_reading.after: إفك is also lived misdirection that turns knowing agents toward powerless objects; the final return announces an unavoidable reorientation to the source they displaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idols function as social infrastructure. Shared affection binds people around them, allies promise nearness and support, and the resulting network resembles a built shelter; its apparent fixity masks structural weakness, exposed when mutual affection reverses into repudiation and expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Strength and fixity supply the idols' apparent capacity to stabilize a collective.
A mainstay on which an affair rests supplies the support function that the focus denies.
Affection supplies the interpersonal adhesive explicitly associated with taking the idols.
A connection standing between parties makes the idol-mediated bond structurally legible.
Expulsion under anger supplies the final reversal of the bond into mutual exclusion.
Love, support, and alliance identify what the substitute network is expected to provide.
The web-weaving spider supplies a constructed network whose many connections can look like infrastructure.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protective function claimed for the network.
Loss of strength supplies the hidden engineering verdict on the apparent shelter.

structural_cues: 29:25 repeats the focus's idols and 'apart from God,' then glosses their worldly function as affection between the group.
29:25 predicts reciprocal repudiation and cursing; 29:41 converts substitute allies into the surah's spider-house comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idols as mutual affection, substitute allies, a woven house, weakness, and later reciprocal expulsion; I infer that the idols mediate a coalition whose social insurance is part of their claimed provision. The concrete cult object remains a live referent rather than being dissolved into sociology.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects stone cult objects because they cannot provide food.
changed_reading.after: The focus also dismantles idol-mediated social insurance: the objects stabilize a network of affection and alliance, but that apparent support-house cannot own provision and disintegrates when protection is needed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counterfeit reality is maintained by presentation and practice. Actions are beautified, that attractive surface blocks the road, and even people possessing sight remain diverted; the focus's 'creating a lie' thus includes skilled production of plausibility, not only saying an untruth.

activation_trace.role: Measured shaping anchors the focus's constructive work of fitting the falsehood into form.
Displaying something as beautiful supplies the persuasive surface applied to the community's deeds.
Turning away and obstructing supplies the behavioral effect of the attractive fabrication.
The extended road supplies the true course from which beautified practice diverts.
Inner discernment makes the diversion surprising: plausibility can redirect even where some insight remains.
Skilled workmanship sharpens the lie as an artifact of practiced human production.

structural_cues: 29:38 sequences beautified deeds, obstruction from the road, and continued possession of sight.
29:45 ends a practice-centered passage by naming what the addressees manufacture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, obstruction, a road, retained sight, and skilled making; I infer a causal arrow from crafted attractiveness to durable misdirection. The live alternative is that Satanic beautification and the focus's تخلقون are parallel but independent descriptions.

changed_reading.before: The lie is a false proposition attached to an idol.
changed_reading.after: The lie is also a designed plausibility system: repeated actions are shaped and beautified until they obstruct another route even for people capable of seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated formula 'at God' marks authoritative provenance, while later provision is something a moving creature need not carry, something expanded or narrowed, and something descending as water that revives land. Seeking provision at God therefore means entering the giver's circulation rather than locating an inert stockpile.

activation_trace.role: Presence and nearness anchor the focus's 'at God' as relation to a source.
Rain descending as provision supplies a dynamic life-bearing form of the focus noun.
Manifest signs also being 'at God' shows the formula marking authoritative possession or provenance, not a physical warehouse.
Visible carrying supplies the negated storage model: the moving creature does not bear its provision inventory.
Spreading and extension supply provision's variable outward flow.
Constriction to a measured amount supplies the opposite modulation of that flow.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material carrier of life-giving provision.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the realized effect of provision's circulation.

structural_cues: 29:50 repeats عِندَ ٱللَّهِ for signs, extending the focus formula beyond food.
29:60-63 sequence non-carrying creatures, divine providing, expansion and constriction, then rain and revived earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated provenance formula, non-carrying creatures, modulation of provision, and water-to-life sequence; I infer that provision is a governed circulation rather than a hoard. A live alternative is that 'at God' remains ordinary locative rhetoric and رزق primarily names concrete food.

changed_reading.before: Seek food from God because idols have none stored to give.
changed_reading.after: Seek from God as the authority of a mobile, measured, life-making circulation; the contrast is not between two warehouses but between the giver's active flow and substitutes with no control over it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distinguishes momentary correct attribution from durable gratitude. Peril strips devotion clean, rescue is followed by renewed association, and secure blessing is then covered over; شكر in the focus is the practice of preserving the giver-benefit relation after delivery and safety.

activation_trace.role: Recognizing and displaying a benefaction anchors gratitude as correct attribution to the giver.
Praise opposite blame supplies the voiced acknowledgment after water and revived earth.
Purity after mixture supplies crisis-induced clearing of rival attributions.
Reassociation after rescue supplies the relapse that gratitude must prevent.
Good condition and blessing identify security itself as delivered benefit.
Covering a blessing supplies the precise failure of provenance once safety feels ordinary.

structural_cues: 29:63 moves from rain and revived land to الحمد لله.
29:65-67 move from danger and exclusive devotion through rescue to renewed association, then contrast belief in falsehood with covering God's blessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praise after provision, purified crisis-devotion, post-rescue association, and covered blessing; I infer that shukr is durable source-recognition across changing conditions. The alternative is a narrower command to verbal thanks accompanied by worship.

changed_reading.before: After receiving provision, people should thank God.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is the discipline that keeps provision attached to its source after crisis passes; without it, benefit becomes ordinary, its giver is covered, and dependence is reassigned to substitutes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The paved-road and scattered-route images are form-distant from ordinary cultic worship, so this should be rendered as a spatial activation rather than a lexical replacement. It remains anchored in the repeated ع ب د of the focus and is reinforced by the surah's obstruction and guidance of paths.

activation_trace.role: A leveled, repeatedly traveled road supplies worship as habit that makes one course easy to traverse.
Routes scattering in every direction supply the centrifugal alternative produced by rival services.
Diversion and obstruction show a false practice actively closing access to a route.
The extended traveled way gives the route metaphor an explicit surah-level object.
Gentle direction to a road supplies the positive reorientation achieved through striving.
Plural extended paths keep divine guidance from collapsing into a single material track.

changed_reading.before: Worship consists of discrete acts offered to an object.
changed_reading.after: Repeated service also paves a route of dependency: false worship makes a misdirected course habitual, while the imperative to worship God begins repaving movement toward the return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The animal-feeding, greening, milk, and rain images are cross-domain branch activations, not substitutes for the normal meaning 'give thanks.' They remain anchored in the focus's رزق-to-شكر sequence and gain material coherence from the surah's water reviving land; downstream prose should mark the feedback reading as exploratory.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision supplies the life-bearing input to the feedback image.
A little feed or rain producing visible thriving supplies gratitude as responsive uptake that manifests the gift.
Fullness and abundant milk supply an intensified image of benefit becoming productive return.
Delivered water supplies the concrete input that reaches an otherwise dead receiver.
Rain-born vegetation makes the receiver's visible revival the effect of correctly received provision.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude verbally acknowledges provision after it arrives.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gratitude is also the living uptake by which a small delivered good becomes visible flourishing and productive return rather than remaining inert or being attributed elsewhere.

strongest_changes: The focus's worship-provision contrast became an audit of effective patronage: allegiance follows imagined control of benefit and risk.
تخلقون إفكًا became counterfeit world-production, sharpened by divine beginning, re-creation, and creation with truth.
The idols became mediators of a fragile social support-house built from affection and alliance, not merely isolated cult objects.
Provision became governed circulation and gratitude became durable preservation of its provenance after safety returns.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition linked the focus's compact sequence of making, serving, owning, seeking, thanking, and returning into one directional system: humans construct plausible support relations, inhabit them as dependents, and are finally reoriented toward the actual source. The spider-house and the late provision-rain-rescue sequence supplied the most consequential activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The social-infrastructure reading should not erase the concrete idol referent.
The circulation sense of provision is strongly patterned but does not by itself settle how active seeking relates to material labor.
The paved-route and productive-uptake readings depend on remote branch images and should remain explicitly exploratory.
